name: Find Places
description: Search Amap (高德地图) POIs right inside TREK — restaurants, sights, hidden gems — and copy details or add them to your trip in one click, with coordinates, map link & phone included automatically.
author: imusic-487

settings.label: Amap Web Service Key
settings.placeholder: Get one from console.amap.com (Web Service type)

settings.label: Fix coordinates: parallel Amap requests per batch

options.label: 5 (fastest, needs headroom on your Amap key's QPS quota)

settings.hint: Higher values scan faster but send more simultaneous requests to Amap — lower this if your key hits rate limits.

settings.label: Fix coordinates: search near existing coordinates first

options.label: On (default) — search near the place's current coordinates
Off — search by name only, like a plain Amap keyword search

settings.hint: Prevents same-named places elsewhere (chain branches, same-named spots in another district) from being picked when a place already has coordinates.

settings.label: Fix coordinates: search radius around existing coordinates (meters)
settings.hint: Only used when the setting above is On. Places with no matching result within this radius are skipped rather than fixed with a guess.
